draft.title: Size of a business
card: Businesses can be sorted by size. One common way is to count the number of people they employ. The Australian Bureau of Statistics (ABS) uses this method.
fewer than 20 employees, such as a local café or a hairdresser.
200 or more employees. Most Australian businesses are small, and large ones are few in number.
draft.remember: Count the employees: under 20 is small, 20 to 199 is medium, 200 or more is large.

a.q: Which business would the ABS classify as medium?
opts: A bakery in Orange with 45 employees
A bookshop in Hobart with 8 employees
A freight company in Perth with 350 employees
A plumber in Cairns with 19 employees
a.why: The medium range is 20 to 199 employees, so 45 fits. The plumber has 19, which is just under 20, so that business is small.
a.clue: Check which number falls between 20 and 199.

b.q: Priya's online store in Adelaide has 18 employees and sells more than any other shop in its street. Dan's farm in Dubbo has 210 employees. How does the ABS classify them?
opts: Priya's is small and Dan's is large
Priya's is medium and Dan's is large
Priya's is small and Dan's is medium
Priya's is medium and Dan's is medium
b.why: The ABS sorts by employee numbers, not sales. Priya has fewer than 20 employees, so her business is small, however much it sells. Dan has 200 or more, so his is large.
b.clue: Sales do not decide the size, only the head count does.

a.best: A bakery in Orange with 45 employees

b.best: Priya's is small and Dan's is large

problems.detail: The clue 'Sales do not decide the size, only the head count does.' points straight to the answer by ruling out the sales distractor, so it gives the answer away.

'Priya's online store in Adelaide' that 'sells more than any other shop in its street' is confusing, because an online store has no street location, so students may read the scenario as contradictory.

screen.summary: The card matches the ABS thresholds and both answers are correct. The question b clue gives away the answer, and the online-store-in-a-street wording is confusing.

a.best: A bakery in Orange with 45 employees

b.best: Priya's is small and Dan's is large
